svg.title: Three Bohemia case groups in March 2014; three separate July legal authorizations
svg.desc: An original non-geographic evidence schematic. The Southeast Louisiana Flood Protection Authority-East March 20, 2014 board minutes grouped Bohemia matters as successor land dockets 55-774, 563586, and 61-051; Heirs of Dr. Thomas Burt dockets 58-217 and 561174; and Union Benevolent Association dockets 59-384 and 540151. On March 20 the board voted to follow counsel's advice specifically in case 59-384. On July 24 it adopted three separate resolutions: 07-24-14-10 authorizing a settlement offer in the successor cases; 07-24-14-12 directing counsel to proceed as recommended in the Burt heirs case; and 07-24-14-13 authorizing counsel-recommended actions to settle Union Benevolent case 59-384. None is a signed agreement, bank receipt, or proof of beneficiary distribution.
svg.metadata: Original analytical vector artwork © Final Vestige Studios, 2026-11-16. Creator: Final Vestige Studios. Source: March 20, 2014 Flood Protection Authority–East board minutes, printed pp. 10–11, https://www.floodauthority.org/wp-content/uploads/minutes/2014%2003%2020%20-%20Board%20Meeting%20Minutes.pdf; July 24, 2014 board minutes, Resolutions 07-24-14-10, 07-24-14-12 and 07-24-14-13. Illustration depicts documented docket associations and distinct authorizations, not executed settlements or claimant payment.
